title: Lemongrass Takrai Dal
description: A flavorful Indian-inspired dal made with lemongrass and takrai, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This comforting dish is rich in protein and fiber, making it a nutritious option for a busy evening.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add chopped onion and sauté until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add minced garlic and sauté for 1 minute.
Add chopped lemongrass and sauté for 1 minute.
Add red lentils, turmeric, cumin, coriander, and salt. Stir to combine.
Add mixed greens (takrai) and stir to combine.
Add 4 cups of water to the pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes or until the lentils are tender.
Stir in some chopped fresh cilantro or scallions, if desired.
Serve hot, garnished with additional cilantro or scallions, if desired.
